'''Fermin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who sold melee weapons in the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Fermin lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] where he ran a weapon-selling business located at the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]].<ref name="TOR" />
